entry.title: New in the Regulation Desk: when a procedure's next step is close to the end of its window, late or reached, and when a forecast moves by two months or more
entry.summary: The window is the latest day the step can come without moving the median of publication by more than 14 days; each story says what it means from the forecast's data.

entry.title: New in the forecast: is the next step on track, and how has the forecast moved since the proposal?
entry.summary: Each open procedure shows until when its next step can come without delaying publication, and what has shifted the forecast since the initial assessment; also on the act pages and the procedure overview.

entry.title: New: funding for the acts we follow, with open calls, funded projects and their partners
entry.summary: Every act page has a section "Funding" and the overview lists all calls of the ECCC, the projects with their partners and German programmes such as WIPANO; deadlines appear under "Coming up" and "This week in the EU", and a new desk "Funding" reports calls naming an act when they open.

entry.title: Easier to see and to tap: links keep a clearer underline, and "Low relevance" is an outline square
entry.summary: Links in lists and tables are at least 24 pixels high; the rating "Low relevance" no longer looks like "Monitor", on the pages and in the timeline drawings.
